changelog: v1.4.0 — Easy Bids: a new tab for LinkedIn Easy Apply jobs, between Out Bids (was Bid) and Add Jobs (was Add job). Open a job on LinkedIn: the panel reads its company, title and description, checks TailorResume for it (same posting or same company + title) and adds it when it is new; its CV is written by ChatGPT and saved to Downloads by itself. Jobs a profile can't take (already applied, skipped, another region or tech stack, not Easy Apply, a duplicate company this month) are shown, not added. Out Bids now lists only jobs that apply on the company's site; Easy Bids lists the LinkedIn ones.
